items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered "StyleSmuggler," an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and is under active exploitation. All current versions are affected, and attackers are injecting malicious code into Magento's template system.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin provides security updates for Adobe Commerce, likely addressing critical or high severity vulnerabilities based on the nature of Adobe Commerce security advisories.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
